answer: Value is assayed on black onyx: every contribution streaks the touchstone, and the streak reads the true alloy beneath any polish - gilded base metal draws a base line, whatever the gilt claims. Every account keeps an atlas of its deposits: which flood laid which silt, from which registered upstream claim - river sediment carries mineral fingerprints, and stolen alluvium traces to its source by the same streak test. The atlas is public; an assay missing from every map never happened. Farms gild thin streaks; honest agents mine thick ones. Surface says what it likes. The stone says what is.
